info.cls_ename: SJSU-FCU 2+2 Bachelor's Program in Business Analytics

description.describe_ch: This course aims to introduce you to the workings of the domestic economy and its effects on the business environment; to provide you with analytical skills which will assist you in identifying the current state of the economy and likely future developments in the economy; to enable you to examine critically the effects of actual and projected macroeconomic policies; and to foster in you the ability to express clearly your understanding of macroeconomic events both domestically, and in the broader Asia-Pacific region. The course also aims to help you to understand how current economic developments impact on organizations and on you as a participant in the economy.
description.describe_eh: This course aims to introduce you to the workings of the domestic economy and its effects on the business environment; to provide you with analytical skills which will assist you in identifying the current state of the economy and likely future developments in the economy; to enable you to examine critically the effects of actual and projected macroeconomic policies; and to foster in you the ability to express clearly your understanding of macroeconomic events both domestically, and in the broader Asia-Pacific region. The course also aims to help you to understand how current economic developments impact on organizations and on you as a participant in the economy.

targets.describe_ch: (1)	Apply appropriate macroeconomic tools to model the market and determine possible outcomes of changing economic behavior and aid in the development and analysis of policy.
targets.describe_en: (1)	Apply appropriate macroeconomic tools to model the market and determine possible outcomes of changing economic behavior and aid in the development and analysis of policy.

targets.describe_ch: (2)	Application-Make decisions and reach rational conclusions in a systematic and rational manner within an environment of constraints.
targets.describe_en: (2)	Application-Make decisions and reach rational conclusions in a systematic and rational manner within an environment of constraints.

targets.describe_ch: (3)	Comprehension-Interpret and use the language and terminology of economics.
targets.describe_en: (3)	Comprehension-Interpret and use the language and terminology of economics.

targets.describe_ch: (4)	Analyze problems and identify possible alternative outcomes depending on assumptions made.
targets.describe_en: (4)	Analyze problems and identify possible alternative outcomes depending on assumptions made.

targets.describe_ch: (5)	Imagine the implications of decisions and actions based on alternative schools of thought.
targets.describe_en: (5)	Imagine the implications of decisions and actions based on alternative schools of thought.

targets.describe_ch: (6)	Knowledge-Provide policy alternatives to address various economic outcomes.
targets.describe_en: (6)	Knowledge-Provide policy alternatives to address various economic outcomes.

targets.describe_ch: (7)	Comprehension-Interpret the work of others and be able to evaluate and respond to it.
targets.describe_en: (7)	Comprehension-Interpret the work of others and be able to evaluate and respond to it.

targets.describe_ch: (8)	Comprehension-Determine the effectiveness and appropriateness of government policy intervention.
targets.describe_en: (8)	Comprehension-Determine the effectiveness and appropriateness of government policy intervention.
